name: @aburi/e2e-integration
description: End-to-end tests. Exercises @aburi/cli against its fixtures/nestjs-billing project (runInit / runScan / runDiff imported directly, no subprocess spawn) with three PR-shaped fixture-mutation scenarios, plus @aburi/core scan orchestration through real plugins. Snapshots are structural (component counts, diff status distribution, gate outcome) rather than byte-exact — a full IR snapshot would rot on every plugin tweak.
